Do not treat a source authority claim as automatically verified. Cite visible snippets for known operands and limitations. For each calculation use named operand roles: minuend minus subtrahend, current relative to baseline, or part divided by total. In the JSON use the string unavailable for an unknown role and none when no limitation basis applies. Separate known input, competing evidence and limitation snippet IDs. Set limitation_basis to documented only when limitation excerpts document it; use not_established when the presented evidence does not establish an input, without claiming the whole document lacks it. Assess source authority and competing evidence yourself; cite the relevant excerpts and explain your assessment.
